// Uses of IconTile: screens of the first corpus and blocks of the notation reference that write it,
// taken by tool/dictionary_closure.dart --harvest (the most shapes of it first). Do not edit: run it again.
### tool/vocabulary/corpus/b01/answers/habit-tracker.txt ### New habit
state name=""
state icon="directions_run"
state color="#FF1E88E5"
state dow=[true,true,true,true,true,false,false]
state target=1
state unit="times"
Page
  Nav
    Row gap=8 middle
      IconButton "close" tooltip="Cancel" onTap={go today}
      Heading "New habit" level=1
    Button "Save" onTap={habits=append(habits,{"id":"h{length(habits)+1}","name":name,"icon":icon,"color":color,"streak":0,"best":0,"done":false,"week":[0,0,0,0,0,0,0],"target":target,"unit":unit,"paused":false,"reminder":"08:00"}); toast "Habit added"; go today}
  Section narrow
    Column gap=20
      Input "Name" "e.g. Stretch for 10 minutes" @name
      Column gap=8
        Text.fieldLabel "Icon"
        Grid cols=6 gap=8
          each i in ["directions_run","menu_book","water_drop","self_improvement","fitness_center","bedtime","restaurant","savings","code","brush","music_note","pets"]
            ChoiceChip "{i}" icon="{i}" selected={icon==i} onTap={icon=i}
      Column gap=8
        Text.fieldLabel "Colour"
        Row gap=12
          each c in ["#FFEF6C00","#FF1E88E5","#FF00ACC1","#FF8E24AA","#FF43A047","#FFE53935"]
            Box w=36 h=36 radius=18 fill={c} border-width={color==c?3:0} onTap={color=c}
              if color==c
                Icon "check" color=#FFFFFFFF
      Column gap=8
        Text.fieldLabel "Repeat on"
        Row gap=8
          each d in ["M","T","W","T","F","S","S"]
            FilterChip "{d}" selected={dow[index]} onTap={dow=setAt(dow,index,!dow[index])}
      Row gap=12 bottom
        Input "Target per day" type=number @target grow
        Select "Unit" items=["times","minutes","pages","glasses","km"] @unit grow
      Card gap=8
        Row gap=12 middle
          IconTile "{icon}" color={color}
          Column grow
            Text.strong "{name==""?"Your habit":name}"
            Text.muted "{target} {unit} a day, {count(dow,x=>x)} days a week"
### tool/vocabulary/corpus/b07/answers/tower-defense-map.txt ### Wave Summary
state wave=4
state reward=62
state picked=""
state perks=[{"id":"gold","name":"War Chest","desc":"+80 gold now","icon":"paid"},{"id":"dmg","name":"Sharpened Arrows","desc":"Archers deal 15% more damage","icon":"gps_fixed"},{"id":"life","name":"Mend the Wall","desc":"Restore 3 lives","icon":"favorite"}]
Page
  Nav
    Brand "Bastion Line" icon="shield"
    Text.strong "Wave {wave} cleared"
  Section narrow
    Column gap=16
      Heading "Wave {wave} cleared" level=1
      Row gap=24
        Card grow gap=4
          Text.muted "Enemies defeated"
          Text.strong "38" size=32
        Card grow gap=4
          Text.muted "Gold earned"
          Text.strong "+{reward}" size=32
        Card grow gap=4
          Text.muted "Lives lost"
          Text.strong "0" size=32
      BarChart values=[14,22,30,38] labels=["W1","W2","W3","W4"] h=160
      Heading "Choose a reward" level=3
      Grid cols=3 gap=16
        each p in perks
          Card gap=8 selected={picked==p.id} onTap={picked=p.id}
            IconTile {p.icon}
            Text.strong "{p.name}"
            Text.muted "{p.desc}"
      Button "Continue to wave {wave+1}" disabled={picked==""} onTap={emit pickPerk picked; go battle}
### tool/vocabulary/corpus-define/d02/answers/tower-defense-map.txt ### Battle
state gold=250
state lives=20
state wave=3
state totalWaves=10
state speed=1
state paused=false
state running=true
state selPlot=""
state selTower=""
state result=""
state bonus=40
state plots=[{"id":"p1","x":0.18,"y":0.30,"tower":""},{"id":"p2","x":0.42,"y":0.62,"tower":"archer"},{"id":"p3","x":0.58,"y":0.28,"tower":""},{"id":"p4","x":0.80,"y":0.55,"tower":"cannon"}]
state towerTypes=[{"id":"archer","icon":"gps_fixed","name":"Archer","cost":60,"range":0.18},{"id":"cannon","icon":"adjust","name":"Cannon","cost":120,"range":0.14},{"id":"frost","icon":"ac_unit","name":"Frost","cost":90,"range":0.16},{"id":"mage","icon":"auto_awesome","name":"Mage","cost":150,"range":0.20}]
state levelsOfTower={"archer":1,"cannon":1}
state speedLabel=""
state sfx=false
every 1s when running && !paused onTick={gold=gold+1}
App
  Main
    Nav
      Row gap=16 middle
        Row gap=4 middle
          Icon "paid" color=#FFF59E0B
          Text.strong "{gold}"
        Row gap=4 middle
          Icon "favorite" color=#FFDC2626
          Text.strong "{lives}"
        Badge.primary "Wave {wave} / {totalWaves}"
      Row gap=8
        SegmentedButton items=["1x","2x","3x"] @speedLabel onChange={speed=indexOf(["1x","2x","3x"],result)+1}
        Button.outline "Next wave +{bonus}" icon="skip_next" onTap={wave=wave+1; gold=gold+bonus; toast "Wave called early, +{bonus} gold"}
        IconButton "pause" tooltip="Pause" onTap={paused=true; open pauseMenu}
    Column pad=16 gap=12
      GameMap path=[[0,0.5],[0.3,0.5],[0.3,0.2],[0.7,0.2],[0.7,0.75],[1,0.75]] plots={plots} wave={wave} speed={speed} paused={paused} selected={selPlot} showRange={selTower != ""} rangeOf={selTower} onPlotTap={selPlot=result; selTower=find(plots,p=>p.id==result).tower; open buildRing} onLeak={lives=max(0,lives-1); lives==0 ? open defeat : toast "An enemy slipped through"} onWaveCleared={wave==totalWaves ? open victory : toast "Wave cleared"}
      if selTower != ""
        Card gap=8
          Row between
            Text.heading "{find(towerTypes,t=>t.id==selTower).name} tower, level {levelsOfTower[selTower]}"
            Badge.info "Range {find(towerTypes,t=>t.id==selTower).range * 100}"
          Row gap=8
            Button "Upgrade ({levelsOfTower[selTower] * 80})" icon="upgrade" onTap={gold >= levelsOfTower[selTower] * 80 ? gold=gold-levelsOfTower[selTower]*80 : toast "Not enough gold"}
            Button.destructive "Sell (+{round(find(towerTypes,t=>t.id==selTower).cost * 0.6,0)})" icon="sell" onTap={gold=gold+round(find(towerTypes,t=>t.id==selTower).cost*0.6,0); plots=updateWhere(plots,p=>p.id==selPlot,p=>with(p,"tower","")); selTower=""; selPlot=""}
            Button.ghost "Close" onTap={selTower=""; selPlot=""}
  Sheet#buildRing "Build a tower"
    Row gap=12 center
      each t in towerTypes
        Column center gap=4 onTap={gold >= t.cost ? gold=gold-t.cost; plots=updateWhere(plots,p=>p.id==selPlot,p=>with(p,"tower",t.id)); selTower=t.id; close : toast "Need {t.cost - gold} more gold"}
          IconTile t.icon
          Text.strong "{t.name}"
          Text.muted "{t.cost} gold"
  Dialog#pauseMenu "Paused"
    Column gap=8
      Button "Resume" onTap={paused=false; close}
      Button.outline "Restart map" onTap={gold=250; lives=20; wave=1; paused=false; close}
      Toggle "Sound effects" @sfx
      Button.destructive "Quit to campaign" onTap={close; go campaign}
  Dialog#victory "Victory"
    Column center gap=12
      Row gap=4
        Icon "star" color=#FFF59E0B
        Icon "star" color=#FFF59E0B
        Icon "star" color=#FFF59E0B
      Text.heading "The line held with {lives} lives left"
      Text.muted "Gold earned: {gold}"
      Row gap=8
        Button "Next map" onTap={close; go campaign}
        Button.outline "Replay" onTap={gold=250; lives=20; wave=1; close}
  Dialog#defeat "Defeat"
    Column center gap=12
      Icon "heart_broken" color=#FFDC2626 size=48
      Text.heading "Bastion Line fell on wave {wave}"
      Row gap=8
        Button "Try again" onTap={gold=250; lives=20; wave=1; close}
        Button.outline "Campaign" onTap={close; go campaign}

// A drawn map with a walking enemy path, plots and range circles is shown as a labelled box.
